scope: DOD-8a retrospective scheduling sensitivity only; no eligibility or acceptance authority
assumptions: Final-head successful ci run with >=60 jobs is a COST proxy, not proof of whole-gate qualification; require complete positive cost and a successful positive-cost independent repro in PR lifetime.
Arrival is earliest selected successful CI creation, not actual ready-for-review; retrospective lookahead and selected successful sample bias.
All selected same-line PRs hypothetically compatible; actual source dependencies, urgency, identity changes and conflicts are unknown; do not use as admission decision.
Composite gate cost assumed max selected member gate+repro minutes; actual composite costs may be larger or smaller.
10 job-minutes per member preflight assumed; 25% recovery model is expected sensitivity not empirical failure rate; stress case adds one complete gate per multi-member batch.
Only selected gate+repro costs compared; other runs/failures/push costs and end-to-end queue contention, verification latency and merge overhead excluded; wait measures staging only.
Last incomplete batches flush at age limit outside observation if needed; separate release lines never mixed; no production dispatch or measured savings.
tests: Synthetic size flush, age flush, separate release lines, max cost, preservation, uniqueness and wait bounds passed in JS runtime
